\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 198-200 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R203-first-pass-words-from-chapters-198-200}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a printer and an address.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a folder, a pay slip, a label, a sign, a map
  \item a helmet, a tunnel, a roundabout, a building site, a building
  \item a branch, a trunk, a thorn, a lawn, a path
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A folder? (\textbf{la cartella}.) A pay slip? (\textbf{la busta paga}.) A label? (\textbf{l'etichetta}.) A sign? (\textbf{il cartello}.) A map? (\textbf{la mappa}.) A helmet? (\textbf{il casco}.) A tunnel? (\textbf{la galleria}.) A roundabout? (\textbf{la rotonda}.) A building site? (\textbf{il cantiere}.) A building? (\textbf{il palazzo}.) A branch? (\textbf{il ramo}.) A trunk? (\textbf{il tronco}.) A thorn? (\textbf{la spina}.) A lawn? (\textbf{il prato}.) A path? (\textbf{il sentiero}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

(\textbf{la palestra}.) A race? (\textbf{la corsa}.) Swimming? (\textbf{il nuoto}.) Skiing? (\textbf{lo sci}.) A contract? (\textbf{il contratto}.) An interview? (\textbf{il colloquio}.) A career? (\textbf{la carriera}.) A printer? (\textbf{la stampante}.) An address? (\textbf{l'indirizzo}.)
